scope: Read-only review of pinned XNU/ext4/libSystem, the existing disposable md0 image, and root-owned desktop launcher. Only this report was written; compositor source remains frozen.

resolved_launcher_blocker.finding: Pinned /sbin/mount rejects -u and -w, so mount -uw / stopped the former set-e script.
resolved_launcher_blocker.evidence: sources/puredarwin-m1-bringup/src/Userspace/diskdev_cmds/mount.c:309-346; actual image binary contains the matching advrt:o: option string.
resolved_launcher_blocker.current_source: integrations/puredarwin/chonkstep-darwin/darwin-desktop-test:10-16 removes the unsupported remount and requires create/write/read/unlink in the mode-0700 runtime directory.

ram_only_storage.recommendation: Use existing ext4-on-md0; no new filesystem or persistent storage is required.
evidence: sources/puredarwin-m1-bringup/src/Kernel/Extensions/ext4/ext4_vfsops.c:104-113 supports mount updates; :188-203 clears read-only for writable root media and enables local locks.
sources/puredarwin-m1-bringup/src/Kernel/xnu/bsd/dev/memdev.c:327-343 copies writes into RAM; :429-431 reports writable.

sources/puredarwin-m1-bringup/src/Kernel/Extensions/ext4/ext4_vnops.c:1419-1446 creates VSOCK; :972-988 preserves unlinked open files; :1287-1348 supports truncate; :2080-2212 implements page-in/page-out.
sources/puredarwin-m1-bringup/src/Kernel/xnu/bsd/vfs/kpi_vfs.c:5833-5848 selects genuine lf_advlock for local-lock vnodes; missing ext4 VNOP_ADVLOCK is not a blocker.

baseline_image_read_only_inspection.method: debugfs without -w and dumpe2fs -h; no mount

ram_only_storage.new_staging_source: stage_ramdisk.py:69 expands to 480M; :90-99 refuses publication below 16 MiB free after payload copy. This review did not execute staging.

socket_and_shm.source_supported: Unix bind/connect, SCM_RIGHTS, local flock, regular-file ftruncate and MAP_SHARED.
socket_and_shm.client_contract: Use an unlinked O_RDWR regular file in the guest RAM root. Keep backing storage alive and do not rewrite a submitted buffer before wl_buffer.release. Smithay maps the received FD READ|WRITE, so a read-only FD is unsuitable.
evidence: sources/puredarwin-m1-bringup/src/Kernel/xnu/bsd/kern/uipc_usrreq.c:1216-1237 creates the socket vnode; :2505 validates SCM_RIGHTS.
sources/chonkstep-darwin/vendor/smithay-0.7.0/src/wayland/shm/pool.rs:262-273 maps shared read/write; :28-41 creates a pthread-backed cleanup thread on pool disposal.
socket_and_shm.posix_shm_caution: XNU posix_shm.c:198-207 uses fo_no_write (ENXIO); :642-645 allows only one truncate. Do not treat shm_open descriptors as ordinary writable files.

kqueue_and_libSystem.method: Read actual libSystem bytes from baseline image and inspect defined external Mach-O LC_SYMTAB entries, not only embedded strings.
kqueue_and_libSystem.source: XNU syscalls.master:413-414,543-544 and kern_event.c:3088,8549; libsystem_kernel/CMakeLists.txt:50-69 generates wrappers from this syscall table.
kqueue_and_libSystem.runtime_qualification: Not established for the compositor/client combination. A successful link does not prove socket FD passing, kqueue delivery, shared-file coherence, SIGBUS handling or pthread cleanup in this guest.

xkb_and_dynamic_dependencies.first_input_off: No keyboard or XKB keymap is initialized; no wl_seat is advertised by that path.
xkb_and_dynamic_dependencies.future_input_blocker: Baseline image lacks /usr/share/X11/xkb. Stage rules, keycodes, types, compat and symbols before enabling --input pdhid.
xkb_and_dynamic_dependencies.keymap_fallback: Smithay utils/sealed_file.rs:55-95 attempts write on Darwin POSIX SHM and fails; input/keyboard/keymap_file.rs:35-44 retains no sealed file and :75-86 uses an unlinked regular temporary file instead. Keep XDG_RUNTIME_DIR writable.
xkb_and_dynamic_dependencies.native_link_receipt_dependencies: CoreFoundation, iconv, libSystem, libc and libm. Their actual files or resolved symlink targets exist in the baseline image; preserve them in the augmented root.

timing_and_evidence.current_source: Launcher starts the client with 120 seconds, waits 100 seconds, then checks owned process liveness; EXIT cleanup terminates those owned PIDs. The former equal-deadline race is removed.
timing_and_evidence.socket_is_not_presentation: Compositor main.rs:36 binds the socket before PDGOP open at :39. DL10_SERVER_SOCKET only proves that the socket exists.
timing_and_evidence.proof_limit: A Wayland callback establishes compositor acknowledgement only. Keep raw nonce-bearing frame evidence and physical panel confirmation separate from protocol success.

checks: Lines 95-101 connect to the launcher-supplied Unix socket and send an empty initial xdg_surface commit. Lines 31-34 acknowledge configure before the first buffer attachment. Input-off requires no wl_seat or XKB.

Lines 102-106 create a new mode-0600 O_RDWR regular file, unlink it while open, truncate to exactly 800*480*4 = 1536000 bytes, then pass its FD through the cached Wayland implementation. The file remains owned throughout the loop; no POSIX-SHM write is used.

Lines 41-44 and 108-122 prohibit rewriting the single buffer until release. seek plus write_all fills the whole backing file before attach/damage/commit/flush. Fixed XRGB8888 little-endian B,G,R,x pixels and stride 3200 match the frozen compositor.

The client writes file bytes rather than mapping them itself. ext4_vnops.c:1242-1248 invalidates resident UBC pages after block-layer write; this is a genuine source path for the compositor's shared-map reads. Actual repeated-frame coherence remains a guest runtime qualification.

Lines 124-130 use prepare_read, flush, poll(POLLIN, 50 ms), then read. Timeout and EINTR drop the unread guard, cancelling the prepared read. Cached wayland-backend 0.3.17 uses Darwin-compatible SCM_RIGHTS, DONTWAIT and SO_NOSIGPIPE handling. XNU sys_generic.c:1684 implements poll.

Missing globals, file/syscall failures, connection failures and absent callbacks return failure. No buffer or callback is fabricated. At process exit the connection and file close; the receiving process owns its transferred FD independently.

nonblocking_findings.finding: The synchronous registry roundtrip precedes Instant::now and can wait indefinitely. The seconds option bounds only the later loop, and cannot bound blocked filesystem syscalls either.
nonblocking_findings.action: Retain the independent host worker timeout. Before using this client as an independently bounded tool, replace startup roundtrip with a deadline-driven sync callback/poll loop. This does not block the current externally supervised attempt.

nonblocking_findings.finding: A transient WouldBlock on flush or read exits the client instead of retrying. This is fail-closed but may cause a false-negative run under socket backpressure or spurious readiness.
nonblocking_findings.action: If encountered, handle WouldBlock with the existing deadline and POLLOUT when outbound bytes remain; do not turn connection/protocol errors into success. No change is required to claim a successful observed run.

nonblocking_findings.finding: README describes chonkstep-shm-client, ARGB8888, adaptive 640x360 dimensions and exit 2. Actual binary is darwin-wayland-client, fixed 800x480 XRGB8888, exactly 48 hex nonce characters, and failure exit 1. paint.rs is not imported by main.rs, so its tests do not validate this executable's renderer.
nonblocking_findings.action: Align documentation and test-coverage claims with the reviewed main.rs before handing off the package.

client_review.evidence_limits: DL10_CLIENT_FRAME is a real compositor callback receipt, not proof of physical scanout. The painted DARWIN / ARM64 / WAYLAND text is a literal, not a uname result; retain artifact/guest binding and fresh nonce-bearing framebuffer or physical-panel evidence separately.
